messages:
sara (AE): Morning — quick async: NovaCorp asks for KMS/HSM specifics and SOC audit timeline. Also they're asking about Dedicated pilot ETA. @oliver (eng) @liam (SE) can you help?

oliver (eng): We support AWS KMS & GCP KMS in Private. HSM (keywrap) is available for Dedicated but still beta — requires SOW. I can attach spec. For SOC: we'll need signed DPA and then security can give a timeline. :wave:

liam (SE): I'll ask NovaCorp for GPU sizing and cert list. Pilot ETA depends on sizing; ballpark 10-14 days after sizing + contract. Current blocker: no sizing from them.

jamal (security): FYI, for HSM we require key import workflow + audit logs. Minimal policy snippet below for their infra team to review:
```
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "*" } ] }
```
We can provide SOC2 docs once DPA is in place. :lock:

erin (CS): I'm looping in legal for DPA. Also tagging @sara (AE) — please confirm we sent the feature matrix + SLA. I uploaded docs to the deal record.

sara (AE): Thx. Action items:
- @liam follow up with NovaCorp for sizing today
- @oliver share HSM spec + example SOW
- @jamal confirm SOC2 delivery timeline after DPA
I'll update CRM and ping them after lunch. :rocket:

oliver (eng): Uploaded spec here: https://redwood.internal/specs/hsm-dedicated-v1 (internal). If they want on-prem HSM integration we'll need networking details (NAT/firewalls) — flag for infra.

liam (SE): Pinged NovaCorp — they replied 'sending gpu and expected qps by EOD'. will update.

jamal (security): Quick note: if they want BYOK with external HSM, we need to schedule a short tech call. Prefer next Tue. :calendar:

erin (CS): Noted, added calendar hold for Tue 10am PT. If anything moves, I'll update thread.
